central_judgment: The two fixed architectures can diagnose candidate-family support and the separate inner risk-admission gate. They are not complete replacements for the contest Q2 benefit-versus-transaction-cost policy. Including the exact annual B candidate removes one old training infeasibility mechanism by construction; any observed admission increase must not be labelled an identified causal effect of removing forecasts or a risk guarantee.
accepted_study_purpose: Separate the old finite9-price family potentially lacking any observed-training feasible controller from the independent pooled-inner risk support question.
Compare a one-candidate annual positive control and a three-candidate drift-band family while reusing exactly the same fully trained static Q1 components.

Hold all five repeated whole-path partitions, all125 component contexts and all25 outer fits fixed; evaluate both architectures, with no architecture/seed/threshold winner chosen on the outer results.

contest_coverage_block.status: Not a blocker for diagnostic execution; blocker for calling either architecture the final complete Q2 automated policy without further benefit rule.
contest_coverage_block.requirement: Trades or target changes require estimated benefit to justify transaction cost.
contest_coverage_block.annual: A yearly restoration schedule, even after whole-policy empirical admission, contains no per-trade estimated benefit-versus-cost comparison.
contest_coverage_block.drift: TV deviation above a fixed band is a state/transaction-frequency rule. Cost is charged in scored net growth, but that fact alone does not estimate the benefit of each proposed trade relative to its cost.
contest_coverage_block.initial: Mandatory initial allocation remains a clearly labelled modeling convention; it is not evidence that later scheduled trades satisfy the benefit clause.
contest_coverage_block.naming: Use simplified execution diagnostic/positive control; if identifiers annual_gated or drift_band_gated remain, state that gated refers to empirical initial admission, not trade-level net-benefit gating.
contest_coverage_block.no_silent_promotion: The prior hypothetical annual reference can have its identical financial trajectory under a new diagnostic admission rule. It does not become a contest-complete automatic fallback or real adviser service.

fixed_common_accounting.profile: Original C only, H30/L.4, Q2 only when own effective Q1 label Balanced.
fixed_common_accounting.target: Exactly own job static bundle Balanced weights. Fixed target throughout; no update, no mutation of joint30/10/0 normative target floors.
fixed_common_accounting.initial: New account100 in bills, mandatory restore before original year1 returns, one original self-financing .25% transfer fee.
fixed_common_accounting.order: At year t decision use pretrade holdings/weights from observations through t−1; charge a single transfer fee before year-t returns.
fixed_common_accounting.history: Retain originalH, accumulatedCPI, realwealth/peak/MDD and absorbing first-exceedance flag; no annual risk reset.
fixed_common_accounting.pending: After first endpoint MDD−L>1e−12, subsequent decisions hold existing units; holdings still earn market returns. No invented adviser response, re-entry or emergency return.
fixed_common_accounting.terminal: No liquidation fee or year31 trade. A first crossing at year30 is still recorded.
fixed_common_accounting.liquidity: Target reserve convention only; a drift band does not ensure a live bills floor, cash access or purchasing-power guarantee.

annual_gated.candidate_definition: Exactly the frozen same-target annual-until-own-first-breach-then-pending reference B. Restore at every active decision, including zero TV; hold only when already pending.

drift_band_gated.TV: TV_t=.5*sum_j abs(x_j,t/sum_j x_j,t − w_j), computed on current pretrade holdings; dimensionless portfolio-weight fraction.
priority: delta0 => exact annualB active restore branch
drift_band_gated.threshold_numerics: For positive deltas use strict floating comparison TV>delta, no extra numeric tolerance; equality holds. Keep original1e−12 only for risk-event/cap conventions.
drift_band_gated.delta0_identity: Explicit annual branch is required. TV>0 alone may hold at exact-zero drift where B records restore/target_execution; financial equivalence alone is weaker than all-state/action equivalence.
drift_band_gated.no_threshold_search: Exactly0,.05,.10 as a predeclared finite technical family; these are not data-identified customer preferences or established optimal bands.

fixed_training_selection.data: Only nominated complete original training IDs T (72 inner or96 final). Every candidate evaluated over all of T from100 through originalH30.
fixed_training_selection.reference: Own job B using own job target and same originalH/L/cost/pending rule, not parent target and not another architecture cohort.
fixed_training_selection.eligibility: Integer k_candidate <= min(k_B, floor(.1*|T|+1e−12)); no beta grid and no eta/fan is used.
fixed_training_selection.growth: Mean originalH annual log growth, already net of actual fees: mean(log(W_real,H/100)/H).
fixed_training_selection.tie_recommendation: Keep the one global set G>=max_eligibleG−1e−12; then exact lexicographic minimum(mean_excess, mean_nominal_fees, original_candidate_order). If another fee-burden statistic is chosen, freeze its exact denominator before execution.
fixed_training_selection.mean_excess: Mean of MDD−L only where MDD−L>1e−12, otherwise0; declare this convention exactly and retain MDD larger-is-worse meaning.
fixed_training_selection.fee_tie_interpretation: The fixed .25% cost_rate itself cannot break ties because identical across candidates. Mean nominal fees is an observable secondary burden at equal initial100, not a second utility penalty or estimated customer preference. Alternative mean annual fee/pretradewealth would require an explicit formula including initial and pending periods.
fixed_training_selection.empty_family: If Q1 is not Balanced, no Q2 candidate is simulated or financially assigned. Any genuinely empty eligible family remains execution Review with NULLs; never choose from held-out returns.

structural_facts_to_prove_not_market_dis.statement: B with pending after crossing and alwaysannual static evaluation take the same actions until first crossing, so full-H ever-exceedance and first crossing agree pathwise. Their later wealth, MDD severity and fees can differ.

When own Q1 Balanced candidate is training-risk feasible at gamma<=alpha=.1 using the identical event/accounting convention, k_B<=floor(.1*n+1e−12). Thus B is eligible under the proposed absolute-and-B count cap. The frozen current gamma grid is entirely<=.1; gammaNone/Q1Review does not imply any B guarantee.

Both architectures include exactB. Conditional on the preceding Q1/coupling conditions, Balanced final training has at least one feasible candidate. Old selected-beta/refit candidate-family failure is removed mechanically, not learned from outer performance.

Conditional on supported Balanced Q1 inner cases and exact B feasibility, both architectures admit the same whole inner validation chunks before parent inner-risk qualification. Their inner auto set U should match exactly; a mismatch must be explained/audited as an implementation/accounting issue or explicitly unsupported Q1 condition.

The drift family containsB and maximizes eligible trainingG up to1e−12. Hence selected trainingG>=G_B−1e−12 and selected trainingk<=k_B are enforced selection properties. Neither property establishes held-out growth or tail-risk improvement.

The old family, price/beta selection, candidate inclusion and new inner-B qualification all change together. The two-control study does not uniquely identify a causal effect of deleting the unconditional forecast fan.

inner_support_and_final_admission.inner_folds: Four original dynamic inner folds inside each parent S96, each T72/validation24. Own cached Q1 calibrations are used at every job; no new fitting of an outer target inside an inner evaluation.
inner_support_and_final_admission.per_inner_job: For each fixed architecture, select candidate from that T72 training only, then evaluate only the selected delta on its24 held-out IDs, or preserve its Q1/execution case NULLs.
inner_support_and_final_admission.U: Pooled original IDs with observed automated candidate outcomes under that architecture across the four validation chunks, each ID at most once; not all96 if unsupported Q1 chunks exist.
inner_support_and_final_admission.positive_evidence: Require |U|>0. Zero automatic evidence yields Review and conditional risk NULL, not0.
inner_support_and_final_admission.relative_gate: k_selected(U)<=k_B(U), with B evaluated on exactly U and each row using that inner-job72-trained target, sameH/L/cost. The phrase not worse thanB means this aggregate first-event count only.
inner_support_and_final_admission.reference_scope: Do not use all96 B events against subsetU, parent96-trained target on inner24, other architecture auto sets, or outer24 B outcomes for admission.
inner_support_and_final_admission.not_pathwise: Aggregate k<=k_B allows candidate-only events and B-only events to offset. Report event contingency on commonU as a diagnostic; do not say risk is never worse on each path.
inner_support_and_final_admission.architecture_separation: Run and qualify the annual and drift architectures separately. Do not select whichever has better validation/outer metrics as a new meta-policy.
inner_support_and_final_admission.final_order: First preserve final Q1 Review/outsideBalanced case. For final Balanced, an unsupported inner gate yields executionReview; a passed inner gate proceeds to own S96 training selection under the same declared rule. Any final failure yields Review. Only admitted selected final candidate is evaluated on outer24.
inner_support_and_final_admission.no_fallback: Failure of the drift architecture does not automatically switch that customer to annual; the annual control is a separate fixed diagnostic learner. Old B/EQ references remain hypothetical.
inner_support_and_final_admission.no_extra_minimum_coverage: No added minimum number of inner auto paths/fit successes is introduced. Risk and denominator evidence are reported without claiming finite-sample guarantees.
